journey.title: Request diagnosis
journey.subtitle: Correlate the matched route, trace and token records by Trace ID. Refresh only reads records; it never calls the upstream again.
journey.notAi: Regular request: AI token metering does not apply
journey.routeMismatch: The request matched a different route. Check the path, method and route priority.
journey.routeUnavailable: The current route is unavailable or deleted. Existing request evidence remains available.
journey.advice.pending: Records arrive asynchronously; this page briefly polls for them. If none appear, check reporting connectivity, internal credentials and persistent queues.
journey.result.traceMissing: Usage found; trace not found yet
journey.advice.traceMissing: The trace may be delayed, unsampled or expired. This does not mean the request did not execute. Refresh later or reproduce using the debugger.
journey.result.usageMissing: Trace found; AI usage not found yet
journey.advice.usageMissing: Refresh shortly. If usage remains absent, check whether the request predates automatic metering and whether the reporting queue is backed up.
journey.result.authentication: Authentication or authorization rejected the request
journey.advice.authentication: Check the route's authentication policy and the validity and scope of the selected credentials.
journey.advice.rateLimit: Read the rejection reason, then check route policies, tenant quotas and token windows before retrying.
journey.advice.routing: Use the trace to determine whether the gateway or upstream returned 404. Check the incoming path, method, StripPrefix and matched route.
journey.advice.upstream: Read the error type and response first. Then check endpoints, instance health, timeouts and provider status.
journey.advice.request: Read the response and filter execution details; check the model, body and content security policy.
journey.advice.settlement: Inspect the usage ledger and settlement status. Allow automatic recovery before applying a verified manual correction.
journey.advice.usageUnknown: Check stream interruption, provider usage reporting and response format. Unknown usage is not zero; reconcile using provider evidence.
journey.advice.ok: Inspect trace and usage details, or return to route configuration and manually send the next verification request.
